title: Exception filters
objective: An HttpException filter must return a safe status and predictable response body without leaking internals.
misconception: The filter sends an HTTP 500 for a known 404 and exposes the raw exception message.
acceptance: A NotFoundException retains status 404 with a safe error code; unknown exceptions are 500.
securityBoundary: Never return stack traces, SQL fragments, service keys, or raw internal errors.
